THE NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL ACT, No. 47 OF 1980
Order under Section 24C and Section 24D

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 24C and Section 24D of the National Environmental Act, No.47 of 1980 read with Paragraph (2) of Article 44 of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic ofSri Lanka, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President, do by this Order, declare–

(a) that the area of land, the limits of which are described in Schedule I hereto shall be an EnvironmentalProtection Area for the purposes of the aforesaid Act and shall be called the “Warathenna-HakkindaEnvironmental Protection Area” ; and
(b) that for so long as this Order is in force -

(i) any planning scheme or project within the aforesaid Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental ProtectionArea which is in conflict with the provisions of the aforesaid Act, shall cease to operate from thedate of the making hereof ;

(ii) no person other than the Authority or a person authorized by the Authority shall exercise, perform,and discharge any powers, duties or functions within the limits of the aforesaid Warathenna-HakkindaEnvironmental Protection Area ; and

(iii) any person who intends to carry out any activity within the Warathenna-Hakkinda EnvironmentalProtection Area shall carry out only the permitted uses set out in Schedule II hereto and shall obtainapproval from the Authority subject to the conditions set out in Schedule III hereto.

(c) a Monitoring Committee consisting of the members set out below shall monitor the activities taking placewithin the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area in accordance with the guidelines issuedby the Authority :–
(i) a representative of the Authority not below the rank of a Director who shall serve as the Chairmanof the Committee ;

(ii) a representative from the the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka ;(iii) a representative from the District Secretariat of Kandy ;(iv) a representative from the National Building Research Organization ;(v) a representative from the Urban Development Authority ;(vi) a representative from the Department of Wildlife Conservation ;(vii) a representative from the Department of Land Use Policy Planning ;(viii) a representative from the Natural Resource Management Centre of the Department of Agriculture ;(ix) a representative from the Kandy Municipal Council ;(x) a representative each from the Pradeshiya Sabhas of Harispattuwa and Yatinuwara ;(xi) a representative each from the Divisional Secretariats of Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale,Harispatthuwa and Yatinuwara ;(xii) a representative from a community based organization operating in the area.
For the purposes of this Order the “Authority” means the Central Environmental Authority establishedunder the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.
Colombo,13th June, 2017.
SCHEDULE I

Limits of the Warathenna-Hakkinda Enviornmental Protection Area containing in Extent 59.4 hectaresconsisting of the River Mahaweli and all islands falling within, situated in Kandy Four Gravets and GangawataKorale, Harispaththuwa and Yatinuwara Divisional Secretariat Areas in Kandy District in the Central Province, isdepicted in the map set out hereunder and bounded as follows :–

North : From the point where the mid line of Peradeniya-Haloluwa-Katugasthota road meets the mid line of theDodamwala suspension bridge up to the point where the mid line of the Dodamwala suspension bridgemeets the mid line of the Srimath Kuda Rathwaththe Mawatha via mid line of the Dodamwala suspensionbridge.

East :From the above-mentioned last point up to the midpoint of the Gatambe roundabout via the mid line ofSrimath Kuda Rathwaththe Mawatha and the mid line of Deveni Rajasinghe Mawatha and the mid line ofColombo-Kandy Road.

South : From the above-mentioned last point up to the point at Gannoruwa Agricultural Centre junction, where themid line of Colombo-Kandy road meets the mid line of Peradeniya-Haloluwa-Katugasthota Road via themid line of Gatambe bridge and the mid line of Colombo-Kandy road.

West : From the above-mentioned last point up to the point where the mid line of Peradeniya-Haloluwa-Katugasthota Road meets the mid line of the Dodamwala suspension bridge via the mid line ofPeradeniya-Haloluwa-Katugasthota Road.

SCHEDULE II
PERMITTED USES
Uses permitted within the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area :
1. Construction of dwelling houses and setting up of offices and small scale business in private lands withinthe area as approved by the UDA and relevant local authorities.
2. Extension, infrastructure development and renovation of existing dwelling houses and housing scheme.
3. Infrastructure development and renovation of existing offices and business premises.
4. Maintenance and repairing of existing roads, water and electricity supply networks.
5. Carrying out religious, educational and research activities.
6. Setting up of temporary camp sites only for educational and research activities.
7. Reforestation and establishment and maintenance of nurseries and herbal gardens using native speciesonly.
SCHEDULE III
CONDITIONS SUBJECT TO WHICH PERMITTED USES ARE TO BE CARRIED OUT
All permitted uses shall be carried out within Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area, in accordancewith conditions set out as follows :-
1. All applications seeking approval for permitted uses set out in the Schedule II within the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area, shall be made to the Authority.

2. Where any permitted use set out in Schedule II for which approval is sougth, is a prescribed project underPart IVC of the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980 the necessary prior approval for suchprescribed project shall be obtained from relevant authority.
3. Where a permitted use set out in Schedule II is not a prescribed project under Part IVC of the NationalEnvironmental Act, No. 47 of 1980,
(a) a project proposal shall be submitted to the Authority for approval in accordance with a Terms ofReference (ToR) or a questionnaire provided by the Authority ;
(b) The Authority shall evaluate such project proposal through a Technical Evaluation Committeeappointed by the Authority and either ;
i. grant approval for implementation of the proposed project subject to specified conditions ; or
ii. refuse to grant approval for implementation of the proposed project with reasons.
(c) The approval granted by the Authority shall be valid for a period of three years from the date ofgranting the approval.
(d) The applicant shall apply for a renewal of the approval from the Authority, within Thirty (30)working days prior to the date of expiry of the approval.

4. No temporary or permanent construction or any type of development activity shall be carried out ;
(a) in any of the islands ; or(b) in any State land situated
within the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area.

5. No commercial level land blocking out for housing constructions or any other development activity shallbe carried out within Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area other than blocking out ofancestral lands to be distributed among family members.

6. No barrier or activity which hinders the sustainability of the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental ProtectionArea shall be permitted. The Authority shall order removal of such barrier erected or stop carrying outsuch an activity.
7. All development activities related to permitted uses shall be implemented as per the guidelines given bythe Authority.
8. All permitted uses shall be carried out in such a manner as not to harm or disturb the environment orcause nuisance to the public.
9. A five meter (5m) reservation area towards landside from the river bank shall be marked in consultationwith the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka.
10. No person shall, within the five meter (5m) river reservation mentioned in above condition No. 09 ;
(a) construct temporary or permanent structures.
(b) renovate existing buildings without obtaining approvals of the Authority and other relevant institutions.
(c) cause harm or carry out any activity which is likely to cause harm to native flora or fauna species.
(d) carry out any landscaping activity.
(e) carry out any land filling activity.
11. Introduction of any chemical or physical substance into the Area or any alteration to the existingenvironmental conditions shall not be carried out during educational and research activities.
12. No flora or fauna species which possess invasive characteristics or likely to be invasive, shall becultivated, kept within or introduced into the Environmental Protection Area.
13. No construction which hinders the view of the environment or scenic value of the environment shall becarried out.
14. Reclamation of paddy fields, marches, bogs, barren land and low lands shall not be permitted.
15. Waste water or solid waste shall not be discharged or disposed into the Mahaweli River, streams whichconnect to the Mahaweli River, reservation and lands within the abovementioned boundary.

16. Any chemical substance which could alter the physical or chemical quality of the Mahaweli River orwhich could detriment aquatic flora or fauna of the river, shall not be discharged into the Mahaweli River,reservation or any stream which connects to the river within the abovementioned boundary.

17. Mineral extraction or exploration activities by using mechanical or manual methods shall not be permittedwithin the Warathenna-Hakkinda Environmental Protection Area.
18. All permitted activities whether existing or proposed shall ;
(a)have its own integrated management plan for soil conservation, strom water drainage, waste (solidand liquid) management, waste water management and landscape work.
(b)follow guidelines issued by the Authority, local authorities or other relevant institutions in respectof preparation of such plan ; and
(c)be implemented and maintained by the developer accordingly.
19. An administrative charge shall be levied by the Authority for the process of the approval of permitted usesand for monitoring activities related to permitted uses from the project proponent.
20. No activity shall be carried out such a manner so as to disturb the traditional lifestyle of the villagers.
21. Any person who acts in contravention of any condition commits an offence punishable under theprovisions of the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980.
